source: Public viaSocket integration pages (viasocket.com/integrations/<app>), full lists read from page data
caveat: Pages change. Public pages describe the embed catalog; a workspace may show more. Names and descriptions only: input and output schemas are UNVERIFIED.

triggers.name: New Message in Channels
triggers.description: Runs when a new message is received in a specific Slack channel. You can select which channel to monitor.

triggers.name: New User Joined or Updated in Your Org
triggers.description: Triggers when a new user join workspace.

triggers.name: New Message on Slack
triggers.description: Runs when a new message is posted anywhere in Slack — across all channels and direct messages. No channel filter applied.

triggers.name: New member join/leave or updated in channel
triggers.description: Triggers when a user joins, leaves, or updates their profile in the selected Slack channel.

triggers.name: New Mention
triggers.description: Runs when someone mentions your Slack app or user in a channel you belong to.

actions.name: Send Message
actions.description: Send or schedule a message to a channel, user, or thread; supports channel names and IDs.

actions.name: Send Interactive Message
actions.description: Send a message with buttons or a form to collect approvals or responses.

actions.name: Send Block/buttons/Intractive message using AI
actions.description: Send Block, buttons, or slack form using AI

actions.name: View_open BlockKit Modal using JSON
actions.description: Open Model as a response or any BlockKit action

actions.name: Chat_update slack block or message using messageTs
actions.description: Update your open or any other chat message using messageTs

actions.name: Send Message as Thread
actions.description: Post a reply to an existing Slack thread. Supports immediate or scheduled delivery,

actions.name: Create Channel
actions.description: Create a new channel

actions.name: Set Channel Topic
actions.description: Set or update channel topic

actions.name: Message Private Channel
actions.description: Message a private channel

actions.name: Create Private Channel
actions.description: Create a new private channel

actions.name: Get Thread Replies
actions.description: List replies in a Slack thread

actions.name: Edit Channel Message
actions.description: Edit a channel message

actions.name: List all Private Channels
actions.description: To fetch all private channels, you must first manually invite the bot to that channel in Slack. Example: Open the private channel → type /invite @your-bot-name → then retry the action.

actions.name: Find Public channel
actions.description: Find public channel in slack using either the channel's ID or name

actions.name: Get Messages from Slack
actions.description: Retrieve messages from a Slack thread or channel within a selected time range.

actions.name: Add Users to Channel
actions.description: Invite users to a channel

actions.name: Send Direct Message
actions.description: Send a Slack DM to a user

actions.name: Get all Channel Members
actions.description: List all the member in a channel.

actions.name: Get User Information
actions.description: Look up a Slack user by email or name and return selected profile fields.

actions.name: Get User Complete Profile Details by ID
actions.description: Get a user's full profile, including custom fields, by ID.

actions.name: Create Canvas
actions.description: Create a new Slack canvas.

actions.name: List all Public Channels
actions.description: Show all public channels

actions.name: Send Block Kit Message
actions.description: Send or schedule a Block Kit message to channels or users; supports mentions, threads, attachments, and bot options.

actions.name: Update Canvas
actions.description: Edit canvas content & sections.

actions.name: Lookup Canvas Sections
actions.description: Find sections within a canvas

triggers.name: New Attachment
triggers.description: Retrieve recent Gmail messages (optionally filtered by label) that contain attachments, upload those attachments to Viasocket, and return message and attachment details.

triggers.name: New Email Arrives
triggers.description: Runs when new email arrives. Filter by label, sender, or subject and choose to include or ignore replies.

triggers.name: New Email Sent
triggers.description: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new email appears in the Sent mailbox or in a specified label.

actions.name: Send Email
actions.description: send a new email message.

actions.name: Modify Email Labels
actions.description: Add or remove labels on a message or thread; target by thread ID, message ID, or search filters.

actions.name: Reply To Thread
actions.description: Reply to an existing email thread — choose recipients (sender/all/specific), send text or HTML, add attachments, and apply labels.

actions.name: Get Thread Replies
actions.description: Retrieve all messages in a thread excluding those sent from the specified email address.

actions.name: Search_Email_Messages
actions.description: Search emails (manual or AI), resolve custom labels by name or ID, and return message details, attachments, and a next-page token.

actions.name: Get Email Attachment
actions.description: Retrieve attachments from an email by Message ID and return attachment details (filename, MIME type, size) and accessible URLs.

actions.name: Create Email Draft
actions.description: Save an email draft in Gmail with recipients, subject, plain or HTML message, and optional attachments (file URLs or Google Drive files).

actions.name: List_all_Mails
actions.description: Added optional multi-select System Labels filter (Spam/Important/Categories/etc.) mapped to Gmail system label IDs and applied via labelIds param with backward-compatible behavior.

actions.name: Get Gmail Message by ID
actions.description: Retrieve a single Gmail message by message ID, returning headers, plain and HTML body, attachments, and thread info.

keka.note: Subset of 91 actions relevant to Deskhand. Only trigger: Employee Clocks In.

actions.name: Create Exit Request
actions.description: Record resignation and last day

actions.name: List leave types
actions.description: List all leave types in your Keka account.

actions.name: List All Employee Salary Details
actions.description: Search Employee Salary Details by Employee Number

actions.name: List Employee Documents
actions.description: Get documents for one or more employees by email or employee ID. Optionally filter by document type.

actions.name: Find Employees
actions.description: Find employees using search, filters, or recent/all modes with pagination; optionally select which fields to return.

actions.name: Log Employee Clock In and Out
actions.description: Log an employee's clock-in and clock-out times to update attendance records.

actions.name: Create Leave Request
actions.description: Create a leave request for an employee using their email or employee ID, specifying dates, sessions, leave type, and reason.

actions.name: Upload Employee Document
actions.description: Uploads a document to an employee's profile in Keka.

actions.name: Update Employee Details
actions.description: Update employee details

actions.name: Add an new employee
actions.description: Create a new employee in Keka with personal details, job assignment, and salary information.

actions.name: List All Leave Balances
actions.description: Retrieve leave balances for employees, optionally filtered by employee IDs or leave type IDs. Returns combined results for all matching records.

actions.name: List All Departments
actions.description: Retrieve departments, optionally filtering by department IDs or last modified date.

actions.name: List All Locations
actions.description: Retrieve company locations, optionally filtered by location IDs or by last modified date.

actions.name: List All Group Types
actions.description: Retrieve all company group type records (e.g., Department, Location, Cost Center).

actions.name: List All Groups
actions.description: Retrieve all company groups, optionally filtered by group type, system group type, or last modified date.

actions.name: List User Leave Requests
actions.description: Retrieve all leave requests for a specified employee (search by display name, first name, or employee ID), optionally filtered by a from/to date range.

actions.name: List of Holidays
actions.description: Retrieve all holidays for a specified calendar and year.

actions.name: List of Employee Document Attachment Download Url
actions.description: Retrieve a secure download URL for a specific employee document attachment.

actions.name: List all Leave Plans
actions.description: Retrieve all leave plans from Keka, optionally filtered by one or more Leave Plan IDs.

actions.name: List all shift policies
actions.description: Retrieve all shift policies configured in the company's Keka account.

actions.name: List all Tracking Policies
actions.description: Retrieve all tracking policies configured in Keka.

actions.name: List all weeklyoff policies
actions.description: Retrieve all weekly off policies configured for the company; returns each policy's id and name.

actions.name: List all holidays Calendar
actions.description: Retrieve all holiday calendars configured for the company.

actions.name: List all Employee Salaries
actions.description: Retrieve payroll salary records for all employees, including earnings, deductions, contributions, total compensation and effective dates.

actions.name: List all Pay Groups
actions.description: Retrieve all payroll pay groups for the authenticated company.

actions.name: List all Employee FnF Details
actions.description: Retrieve final settlement (FnF) details for one or more employees, or for all employees if none are specified.

actions.name: List of Financial Details for All Employees
actions.description: Retrieve payroll, bank account, and statutory account details for selected employees or all employees.

actions.name: List Employee Form 16
actions.description: Retrieve an employee's Form 16 tax certificate for a specified legal entity and financial year.

actions.name: List Tax Groups
actions.description: Retrieve all tax groups for the specified legal entity.

actions.name: List Employee Expenses
actions.description: Fetch all expenses for a specific employee, optionally filtered by date range or last modified date.

actions.name: List expense policies
actions.description: List expense policies and show key details. Optionally filter by policy IDs or by whether they allow expense claims or travel requests.

actions.name: Update Employee Bank Details
actions.description: Update an employee's bank account and how they are paid in Keka.

actions.name: List Assets
actions.description: View assets with filters

actions.name: Assign Asset to Employees
actions.description: Assign an asset to employees

actions.name: Update Employee Salary
actions.description: Update an employee's salary, salary type, effective date, and optional bonus details in Keka.

actions.name: List Clocked In Employees
actions.description: List clocked-in employees

actions.name: Recover Assigned Assets
actions.description: Recover assigned assets

actions.name: Give Praise To Employee
actions.description: Recognize one or more employees with a badge and feedback, and optionally post the recognition to the company wall.

actions.name: List All Policies
actions.description: Show all company policies

actions.name: List Employee Skills
actions.description: List skills for a specific employee, with optional filters (skill name, rating, skill ID) and last-modified date.

actions.name: Add Skills to an Employee
actions.description: Add one or more skills to a specific employee and optionally include ratings for each skill.

actions.name: List Review Groups
actions.description: Retrieve review groups — fetch specific groups by ID or browse paginated, paged results.

actions.name: List Employee Reviews
actions.description: Retrieve employee reviews, with optional filters for employee, review group, review cycle, status, and pagination.

actions.name: List Helpdesk Tickets
actions.description: List helpdesk tickets with optional filters (status, priority, assignee, employee, category, last modified) and pagination.

actions.name: List Helpdesk Categories
actions.description: Find helpdesk categories in your Keka account. Supports filters for ID, name, parent category, disabled status, and pagination.

actions.name: List Helpdesk Ticket Closing Reasons
actions.description: Retrieve helpdesk ticket closing reasons from your Keka account.

actions.name: Create Helpdesk Ticket
actions.description: Create a helpdesk ticket with title, description, category, priority, reporter (employee ID), and optional assignee.
